_meta.type_source: MAO's Primary Property descriptor from the authenticated sales search. A development is typed when at least one of its rolls carries one; a condo plan is one architectural project, and 98.7% of plans are internally consistent in MAO's own labelling.
_meta.unknown_caveat: Developments with no labelled roll are emitted as unknown, never inferred. The civic-address heuristic (a street address means row housing, 'Unit N -' means apartment) reaches only 36.5% row-housing precision per roll and 61.7% by development majority vote, so it is not used. Dwelling-unit density is worse still.
_meta.lag_caveat: y is the first tax year a roll in the development was ASSESSED, which trails physical completion, typically by about a year.
